coverage_tool: JaCoCo 0.8.15 / Kotlin 1.9.20 authored-method attribution, normal Robolectric debug unit suite on API 27 and 34
reproduction: Independently dispatched onServiceConnected registers the original recipient, emits observed death, then holds linkToDeath before return. Original outgoing job has settled. Before fix retire returns successfully and releases binding; after fix retirement times out without unbind/unlink, then succeeds exactly once after the original callback settles. Removing only the new await reproduces both API failures.
ownership: At most one deferred link receipt is allocated under bindingGate before publishing the single-assignment original Binder. The same gate closes admission if retirement sees no Binder. Receipt completion occurs in callback finally only after the native link call returns/throws. Retirement joins original START/STOP/EXIT work, awaits this receipt outside the gate, then calls original cleanup. Timeout cancels the wait, not the link receipt/callback or binding; retry observes the same obligation. Once-only cleanup and original death proof remain required. Eventual cleanup assumes link/native control calls settle and original death becomes observable; indefinite native failure remains owned. The test holds one private callback, releases its latch and joins execution/callback in finally before final retirement.
review: Independent read-only native reviewer found no remaining defect in the change.
limitations: Hosted Binder fixture proves the specified interleaving; physical Binder timing/provider acceptance remains in T1651. No devices or running sessions changed. No security or microphone/speaker feature campaign resumed.
